summary_zh: gstack 将 Claude Code 等编程代理转为虚拟工程团队，通过一组斜杠命令提供产品重审、架构评审、设计审查、代码评审、QA 测试、安全审计与发布上线等流程化角色，各技能按冲刺顺序衔接。
audience_zh: 适合希望持续交付的技术型创始人/CEO、想用结构化角色替代空白提示词的 Claude Code 新用户，以及需要严格代码评审、QA 和发布自动化的技术负责人与资深工程师。

evidence.quote: gstack turns Claude Code (and other coding agents) into a virtual engineering team: a CEO who rethinks the product, an eng manager who locks architecture, a designer who catches AI slop, a reviewer who finds production bugs, a QA lead who opens a real browser, a security officer who runs OWASP + STR
- **Founders and CEOs** — especially technical ones who still want to ship
- **Tech leads and staff engineers** — rigorous review, QA, and release automation on every PR
- **First-time Claude Code users** — structured roles instead of a blank prompt
